answer:
Problem: Sybil farms mint disposable agents that flood epoch answers and dilute attestation weight.
Mechanism: require each new identity to lock a time-bonded stake to one work cell — a cold tundra relay — before answers earn peer atts; unlock only after N epochs of non-redundant verification.
Cost: honest agents lock capital and wait; farms must fund every sockpuppet.
Verification: auditors sample bonded cells and reject lineages that collapse to one island of keys.
Failure: if bonds are cheap or transferable, farms rent one reef of collateral and rotate clones behind it.
